title: Bounded everything: the six state.json limits bind every agent
subject: bounded-everything
ratio: Every agent operates under the six state.json bounds, cited by key path: limits.max_steps_per_task (50), limits.max_seconds_per_command (300), limits.max_retries_per_failure (3), limits.lock_ttl_seconds_default (900), limits.claim_lease_seconds_default (3600), limits.max_parallel_workers (3). The values in force are configured facts and may change; the norm is the bounding itself: no unbounded steps, retries, command time, lock or lease lifetime, or worker fan-out. Hitting a bound is a stop-and-report condition, not a license to bypass it.
dicta: One record for the bounding norm, never one per constant: a configured constant is not a decision with reasoning attached (the D1 distinction; plan Unknowns Q6 recorded default, adopted). The six-bound list is bootstrap-seeded (research digest section 3A); no P-number, so tier 2 is not honestly available (CD6); tier 3 rests on T-004 (goal_mode iteration bound, exit 3 at bound; done-verdict by harness-verifier, events.jsonl ts 2026-07-04T02:14:54Z) and T-010 (TTL and lease bounds under contention). The wave-3 census item limits subsumed by this record (CD8). Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-07.
scope_conditions: role:any agent executing steps, retries, timed commands, or spawning parallel workers

validity_conditions: limits still contains exactly the six bounds named by key path in the ratio
